title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Frequently asked questions about The Gypsi botanical skincare.
body:
## Are your products plant-based?

Our formulas are plant-based and never tested on animals. 

## Are they suitable for sensitive skin?

They're formulated to be gentle and sensitive skin friendly. As with any skincare, we recommend a patch test.

## What's your return policy?

See our [Shipping & Returns](/shipping-returns.html) page.

## How do I track my order?

You'll receive a confirmation email with tracking once your order ships.

## How do I contact you?

Email us at contactthegypsi@gmail.com and we'll get back to you.
